payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE (commit bb19c3b): job + platform-event claim subqueries use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on Postgres so concurrent worker nodes take disjoint rows (SQLite omits it — single-connection serialization). Fixed a latent PG gap: JobStore.enqueue now INSERT…RETURNING id (lastInsertRowid was 0 on PG). Validated on real Postgres: tests/pg-job-claim-concurrency.test.ts — 8 concurrent claimers / 60 jobs, each claimed exactly once. Projections need no locking (idempotent per-tenant recomputation). Server suite 784 green.
